_comment: Hand-maintained extras per catalog slug. `online` is a short note shown with an 'online multiplayer' badge. Never put server addresses or join keys here. `author` is "ai" for a game an AI designed on its own (the Idea Forge schedule sets it when it publishes one); a slug with no author is shown as human-designed.

great-outdoors.online: Hosted kart racing for up to 8 players. Joining a shared server needs the host's address and join key — ask the host.

reddm.online: Online FPS deathmatch. One player hosts, the others join.

riftraze.online: Online arena FPS. One player hosts, the others join.

killchain.online: Online FPS: team deathmatch, free for all, capture the flag, search and destroy and 1v1 duels on three maps. One player hosts and shares a six-character code; the others paste it.
